page.layout: One page of text in a single column; Hebrew headword lines set in the body with Latin glosses; no marginal notes; running head in Hebrew at top centre; page number at top right.

p.i: in cantu fuisse elevandam, & simul animos ad Deum. Mihi potius communis pausa nota, quòd ibi omnium vocum aequabilis esset pausa, & communis quaedam cantus quasi Prostratio, quod & ipsum gravitati & suavitati in canendo non parum servit.

main_text.p: סָלַח Condonare, Remittere. Niphal נִסְלַח Condonari.
סָלַל Aggerare, Contumulare, Viam sternere & elevare. Pihel סִלְסֵל Extollere. Hithpahel הִסְתּוֹלֵל Extollere seipsum.
סְלֵלָה f. Agger, aggesta terra moles: plural. סְלֵלוֹת Aggeres.
מְסִלָּה f. Aggesta, Strata, Trita via: plural. מְסִלּוֹת Via, Aggeres.
סַלְסִלּוֹת f. p. Quali, corbes vindemiatoria.
סִלּוֹן סִלָּן m. Spina: plur. סִלּוֹנִים.
סֶלַע סֶלַע m. Petra: plur. סְלָעִים.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and glosses are reproduced from the scan as far as legible; vowel points and some letters are partly obscured by staining. The final line סלק is a catchword-like headword at the foot.
